title: Settings
lead: Your name, your handle, your picture, whether you appear on a leaderboard, and the language this browser shows.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.signedInAs: Signed in as {{email}}. The address belongs to your sign-in method and is changed there.
profile.displayNameHint: Shown above your circuits. Leave it empty to be known by your handle alone.
profile.usernameHint: Your public address. Changing it moves your profile page, and every link anyone has to it.
profile.usernameShape: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, from 3 to 32 characters.
profile.avatarProvider: Use the picture from the account I signed in with
profile.avatarHint: There is no upload yet. The drawn picture is derived from your account, so it is always available and it is never anybody else’s file.

privacy.heading: Leaderboards
privacy.listMe: Show my name on challenge leaderboards
privacy.note: Turning this off removes your name from the table other people read. It does not remove your results: your position is still counted, nobody moves up because you are hidden, and your own page still tells you where you stand. Your circuits are never published by a leaderboard either way — a solution is a spoiler.

apiKeys.heading: API keys
apiKeys.lead: Create circuits, run simulations and read results from outside this application. A key acts as your account and can do no more than you can.
apiKeys.empty: You have no API keys yet.
apiKeys.nameHint: What holds this key — “CI”, “my laptop”, “the plotting notebook”. You will need it to know which one to revoke.
apiKeys.scopesNote: Give a key the least it needs. No key can manage keys or submit jobs to real quantum hardware, whatever you tick here.

scopeHint.read: Your circuits, their versions, the gallery and the result of a run.
scopeHint.write: Create, change and delete circuits, versions and collections.
scopeHint.simulate: Run simulations, without being able to change anything.

created.heading: Here is your key
created.body: This is the only time “{{name}}” will be shown. Copy it somewhere safe before you continue.
created.label: Your new API key
created.copyFailed: The clipboard is not available here. Select the field above and copy it yourself.
created.warning: Once you dismiss this, the key cannot be shown again by anyone, including us. If you lose it, revoke this key and create another.
created.dismiss: I have saved it — hide it

row.confirmBody: Revoking “{{name}}” takes effect immediately and cannot be undone. Anything using it will stop working on its next request.

language.heading: Language
language.note: The language is remembered in this browser rather than on your account, so it stays the one you picked here whether you are signed in or not.

danger.heading: Delete your account
danger.body: This removes your circuits, every version of them, your collections and your stars. It cannot be undone.
danger.identityNote: Your sign-in method itself is kept by the provider you signed in with, so signing in again gives you a new, empty account rather than this one back.
